topic: stationary three-state cycle assay with unknown shared emissions

claims.statement: For independent stationary replicate pairs (Y0,Yh) from a common time-invariant column-stochastic 3x3 emission matrix E with certified sigma_min(E)>=sigma_floor>0, H0:d=0 gives population pair skew S=C-C^T=0, while H1:d=4pi/(sqrt(3)tau), s in [s_min,s_max], s_min>d, gives ||S||_F >= (2sqrt(2)/3) sigma_floor^2 exp(-3 s_max h/2)|sin(2pi h/tau)|. The threshold test ||S_hat||_F>=Delta/2, using the empirical pair skew, has each testing error at most alpha for n=ceil((2sqrt(2)+4sqrt(ln(1/alpha)))^2/Delta_*^2) independent pairs at h*=tau/(2pi) atan(4pi/(3s_max tau)), where Delta_*=(2sqrt(2)/3)sigma_floor^2 exp(-atan(x)/x)x/sqrt(1+x^2), x=4pi/(3s_max tau).
assumptions: The hidden three-state cycle is initialized in its uniform stationary law.
The same emission matrix E is used at both pair endpoints and under both hypotheses.
The assay supplies independent reset pairs; overlapping observations from one path are not treated as iid.
tau, s_min, s_max are known and sigma_min(E)>=sigma_floor is certified.
The test uses only lag-h pair asymmetry, not a same-lineage three-time likelihood.
claims.novelty_boundary: Scoped statistical construction for the supplied three-state cycle; no novelty or priority claim.
claims.costs: n independent stationary resets, 2n emission records, and n*h_* cumulative replicate exposure; add calibration and any endpoint-control arm separately.
claims.falsifier: A mistake in the hidden semigroup/skew norm, the emission congruence bound, the bounded-difference constant, or the stated sample-size algebra.
claims.next_gate: Derive the joint three-time likelihood if the same lineage is observed at 0,h,tau; otherwise keep the theorem restricted to independent pair arms.

claims.statement: For E_kappa=kappa I+(1-kappa)11^T/3 and one stationary lag-h pair, the exact chi-square divergence Xi=chi^2(p1||p0) is 4r^2(1-cos(phi))^2/[3(1+2r)] + r^2/(1-r)[2(1-cos(phi))^2/3+2sin(phi)^2], r=kappa^2 exp(-3sh/2), phi=2pi h/tau. Any test with both errors at most alpha<1/2 from n independent pairs must satisfy n>=ln(1+4(1-2alpha)^2)/ln(1+Xi). Independent known-state emission calibration and independent lag-tau alias pairs add zero divergence when shared identically under both hypotheses. At h=tau, Xi=0; at kappa=0, Xi=0 for every h.
assumptions: The same s is used under H0 and H1, with any fixed s in the admissible interval.
The 3-state emitter E_kappa is common under both hypotheses and 0<=kappa<=1.
Process samples are independent lag-h pairs; any lag-tau control arm is a separate independent arm.
Calibration probes emissions from known hidden states independently of the transition dynamics.
claims.novelty_boundary: An explicit two-point lower bound for this finite-state assay, not a general HMM minimax theorem.
claims.costs: The lower bound counts only informative lag-h pairs. Calibration emissions and separate endpoint-alias pairs still count toward total assay cost even though their likelihood ratio is one.
claims.falsifier: An error in the nine-cell observed pair laws, chi-square summation, product tensorization, or the total-variation/chi-square inequality.
claims.next_gate: For a shared path read at 0,h,tau, recompute the joint law and divergence; pairwise alias marginals alone do not establish that triple data are uninformative.

claims.statement: With m_E independent known-state emission standards per hidden state, the empirical 3x3 E satisfies max-entry error<=eta with probability at least 1-18 exp(-2m_E eta^2), yielding the valid lower confidence bound sigma_min(E)>=sigma_min(E_hat)-3eta. A margin promise sigma_min(E)>=sigma_floor+6eta makes the floor certify with probability at least 1-alpha_cal when m_E=ceil(ln(18/alpha_cal)/(2eta^2)). For E_kappa, eta=kappa/12 certifies sigma_floor=kappa/2 using ceil(72 kappa^-2 ln(18/alpha_cal)) standards per hidden state.
assumptions: Each known hidden state can be prepared or reliably labeled for calibration.
Emission samples are independent and use the same stationary assay sensor channel.
A 6eta slack between true sigma_min(E) and the floor to be certified is available.
claims.novelty_boundary: Hoeffding plus Weyl calibration accounting; no novelty claim.
claims.costs: 3m_E labeled-state emission records, plus preparation/sorting/verification of each standard; allocate alpha_cal separately from testing alpha.
claims.falsifier: A failure of the coordinatewise Hoeffding union bound, Frobenius/operator norm conversion, or Weyl singular-value perturbation step.
claims.next_gate: Replace ideal known-state standards with the actual assay's state-label error and preparation cost model, or retain sigma_floor as an explicit external certificate.
